DDD 工作室會議，成員們都坐在位子上了，只剩白還沒進來。

紫翹著腿一副無聊的樣子，金則隨時準備釘她的把柄。

終於，白打開會議室的門。
「這位是新成員，瑟西娜，簡稱瑟（C.Curo）。歡迎她加入DDD。」

/
一名年輕、銀灰長髮，穿著整齊的黑色襯衫打扮，跟在白身後走進來，英氣逼人，但卻不改五官的青澀可愛。

「嘩...」紅和蒼同時張大了嘴。

「...」紫微微低下頭，怎麼找了一個跟她戲路很像的新人？

「紫。」她馬上就被白點名。

「是，白姐。」

「有瑟加入，妳的『小子』演員任務也可以分攤了。」

「我才不需要人分攤。」紫抗議。
更況且。
她看了紅一眼。

跟紅一起演的劇本更不需要分攤！

紅注意到了紫的彆扭，興味的看著瑟跟紫。

ChatGPT
The meeting at DDD Studio was already underway.

Everyone was in their seats.

Everyone except N.White.

L.Night sat with one leg crossed over the other, looking thoroughly bored. Across from her, D.Golden looked like she was simply waiting for the perfect opportunity to catch L.Night doing something she shouldn't.

Then the conference-room door finally opened.

N.White stepped inside, wearing her usual calm smile.

"Everyone, this is our newest member, C.Curo. Please welcome her to DDD."

A young woman followed her into the room.

She had long silver-gray hair and wore a neatly buttoned black shirt. Her sharp, handsome presence immediately stood out, yet somehow it didn't erase the youthful softness of her features.

D.Cyan and E.Red both stared.

"Whoa..."

Their reactions came almost simultaneously.

L.Night, meanwhile, slowly lowered her head.

'...Why did they hire someone who looks like she came out of my casting category?'

She glanced at C.Curo again.

Same general vibe.

Cool. Short-spoken. More handsome than conventionally feminine.

This was already annoying.

"L.Night."

N.White's voice pulled her back.

"Yes, N.White."

"With C.Curo joining us, she can start sharing some of your 'handsome-girl' roles."

"I don't need anyone to share them."

L.Night immediately objected.

Then she glanced toward E.Red.

Besides...

She wasn't about to give up the roles she got to perform with E.Red.

Those were different.

Those were hers.

E.Red noticed the tiny shift in L.Night's expression.

A faint, amused smile appeared on her lips.

Interesting.

Very interesting.

C.Curo, meanwhile, simply looked around the room.

She didn't seem particularly impressed.

Didn't seem nervous, either.

After a moment, she pulled out a chair and sat down.

Her legs crossed neatly beneath the table.

D.Golden's eyes immediately moved toward her.

Then toward L.Night.

Then back to C.Curo.

A strange sense of understanding passed through her eyes.

'Oh.'

She had just found someone who might finally be useful.

C.Curo noticed her staring.

"What?"

D.Golden straightened.

"Nothing."

"..."

C.Curo looked at her for another second.

Then quietly replied,

"Okay."

L.Night's eyebrow twitched.

'Why does that somehow feel more irritating than an argument?'

She leaned back in her chair.

C.Curo glanced over.

Their eyes met.

Neither moved.

Neither spoke.

E.Red's smile grew a little wider.

This was going to be fun.

白將劇本『Sorry』打在投影幕上給全員看，那是她發掘瑟的關鍵作品。

「所以她就只是個『道歉笨蛋』。」紫隨便的說著。

「妳是有什麼事？」金透過桌底下踢了一下她的腳。

「抱歉，我們這隻紫毛貓咪在護食。」紅戲謔的轉頭對瑟微笑。

瑟也對紅微笑。

「妳小子！...」紫才剛急促的把翹腳放下來，白就先出聲了：「紫？」。

/
「哼。」紫別過頭。

/
瑟回頭瞄了紫一眼，嘴角的微笑還在。
！參考附件的Sorry片段。

ChatGPT
N.White tapped the remote.

The projector screen changed.

A title appeared in the center:

**SORRY**

L.Night stared at it.

E.Red leaned forward slightly.

D.Cyan's eyes lit up with recognition.

"This," N.White said, "was the production that convinced me to bring C.Curo into DDD."

She let the opening scene play for a moment before pausing it again.

L.Night glanced at the screen.

Then at C.Curo.

Then back at the screen.

"So she's just an 'apology idiot.'"

D.Golden's foot immediately nudged hers beneath the table.

"What is wrong with you?"

"Nothing."

"You've been making faces since she walked in."

"I haven't."

"You have."

L.Night quietly pulled her leg back.

Across the table, E.Red was already watching her with an amused expression.

Then she turned toward C.Curo.

"Sorry about that."

Her smile became teasing.

"Our little purple cat is just guarding her food."

L.Night's head snapped toward her.

"Hey—"

C.Curo smiled.

Not a big smile.

Just a small, polite curve of the lips.

She looked at E.Red.

Then at L.Night.

"She's cute."

L.Night's eyes widened.

"You little—!"

Her crossed leg dropped immediately as she nearly shot upright.

"N.White's voice came before she could finish."

"L.Night?"

"..."

L.Night slowly sat back down.

"Hmph."

She turned her face away, arms folding tightly across her chest.

C.Curo glanced at her.

The faint smile was still there.

E.Red noticed.

And this time, she didn't even bother hiding her amusement.

D.Golden quietly leaned toward E.Red.

"She's already irritated."

E.Red whispered back,

"No."

She looked at L.Night.

"She's already interested."

L.Night's ears practically turned red.

"I can hear you."

"Good."

"Hmph."

C.Curo lowered her eyes, hiding another tiny smile.

Apparently, joining DDD was going to be more entertaining than she had expected.

白介紹完了。
「暫時，因為房間有限，瑟還不會搬進工作室。...」

「小瑟瑟可以跟蒼姐姐睡呀～🩵🩵🩵」

瑟回頭看向她，依然掛著禮貌的微笑。

「不行...會被妳嚇跑。」白瞇起眼。

「她明天就失貞了。」金補刀。

「喂喂～？🩵🩵好吧，也是啦～？」蒼還故意對瑟若有似無眨了眨眼。

『這傢伙..定力真好，肯定只是新人期間在假裝聽話。』紫的內心依然充滿威脅與較勁。

「隔壁棟買下來吧，然後打通。房間越來越不夠了。」黑宣佈。

全體都看向她。

「況且，雪、艾如果來開會，也不用趕著回去或是住旅館，我們還能有客房。」

「為了這小子？」紫身子往前傾，一臉難以置信。

「我是女的。」

「我管妳？」

「嗯？」瑟瞟了紫一眼。
「哼。」接著冷笑。

『定力很好...』金、蒼、紅的內心同時想。

ChatGPT
N.White finished the introduction.

"For the time being, we don't have enough rooms, so C.Curo won't be moving into the studio just yet..."

D.Cyan immediately raised her hand.

"Little C.Curo can sleep with big sister D.Cyan~ 🩵🩵🩵"

C.Curo turned toward her.

She was still wearing that same polite smile.

"No..."

N.White narrowed her eyes slightly.

"She'd run away from you."

D.Golden immediately added,

"She'd lose her virginity tomorrow."

"Hey, hey~? 🩵🩵"

D.Cyan blinked innocently, then looked at C.Curo again.

"Okay, fair point~?"

She even gave C.Curo a deliberately ambiguous little wink.

C.Curo merely continued smiling.

L.Night watched the exchange in silence.

_That woman..._

_Her composure is way too good._

_She's definitely just pretending to behave because she's new._

L.Night's eyes narrowed.

_Just wait._

"This building next door."

D.Dark suddenly spoke.

"Buy it. Then knock through the two buildings."

Everyone turned toward her.

"There aren't enough rooms anymore."

She calmly continued.

"Besides, if Icy or Arte come over for meetings, they won't have to rush home or stay at a hotel. We could also have guest rooms."

The room went quiet for a moment.

L.Night leaned forward.

"For this guy?"

Her expression was full of disbelief.

C.Curo finally looked toward her.

"I'm a woman."

"I don't care."

"..."

C.Curo glanced at L.Night.

"Hm?"

Then she gave a quiet little scoff.

"Hmph."

She turned away again.

L.Night froze.

The room fell silent for half a second.

D.Golden, D.Cyan, and E.Red all looked at each other.

The same thought appeared in all three minds.

_Her composure is really good..._

紫立刻一把摟住紅的腰。
「紫？幹嘛啦？」紅一陣錯愕。

「喂！新來的小子，這是我女朋友，勸妳記好這件事。」她喊住走向起居室的瑟。

瑟頓了頓，回頭看紫和紅。
紅正在有點扭捏的推開紫。

瑟輕輕挑眉。

「別理那隻炸毛紫貓咪。女朋友？被她親手丟在工作室然後人就出去遊旅了。」金突然出現在瑟身旁，拍了拍她肩膀。

「我也是半個紅的女朋友好嗎？要不是紫突然歸隊。」金指了指自己。

瑟的視線轉向金，忍不住，視線往下漂了不到一秒又收回去，一臉沒事的樣子點點頭。

「什麼遊旅！我是出去獨自加強自己！」紫。

「哪個部分加強了？嘴砲？」金。

「大家感情真好。」瑟突然悠悠拋出這句。

「妳小子！」紫放開紅，快步衝到瑟面前。
才發現自己竟然比對方還矮了一點。...

「嗯？」瑟故意略帶戲謔的『低頭』看紫。

The meeting was over.

Everyone scattered around the studio.

Some headed toward the living room. Others went back to their rooms.

L.Night immediately slipped an arm around E.Red's waist.

"L.Night? What are you doing?"

E.Red looked genuinely caught off guard, awkwardly trying to push her away.

"Hey!"

L.Night called out to C.Curo, who was already walking toward the living room.

"New girl! This is my girlfriend. You'd better remember that."

C.Curo stopped.

She turned around and looked at L.Night and E.Red.

E.Red was still trying to pry L.Night's arm away.

Then C.Curo raised one eyebrow.

Before she could say anything, D.Golden suddenly appeared beside her and casually patted her shoulder.

"Don't mind that grumpy purple cat."

D.Golden gestured toward L.Night.

"Girlfriend? She dumped E.Red here at the studio and then went off traveling."

"I'm also half E.Red's girlfriend, you know?"

D.Golden pointed at herself.

"Wouldn't have happened if L.Night hadn't suddenly come back."

C.Curo's gaze shifted to D.Golden.

Her eyes dipped downward for less than a second before immediately returning to D.Golden's face.

She gave a perfectly composed nod.

"I see."

"What do you mean, 'went traveling'?!"

L.Night protested.

"I went out to strengthen myself!"

D.Golden didn't even blink.

"Which part did you strengthen? Your trash-talking?"

"Hey!"

E.Red covered her mouth, trying not to laugh.

C.Curo watched the three of them bicker for another moment.

Then, in her usual calm voice, she casually remarked,

"You all seem to get along well."

L.Night's head snapped toward her.

"You little—!"

She released E.Red and marched straight toward C.Curo.

One step.

Two.

She stopped directly in front of her.

Then froze.

...

Why was she shorter?

L.Night slowly looked upward.

C.Curo was just a little taller than her.

Not much.

Just enough.

C.Curo noticed.

A faintly mischievous glint appeared in her eyes.

She deliberately lowered her gaze.

"...Hm?"

She looked down at L.Night.

L.Night's expression immediately stiffened.

D.Golden covered her mouth.

E.Red's shoulders began trembling.

D.Cyan, who had just walked into the room, stopped dead.

Nobody said anything.

That somehow made it worse.

L.Night's eye twitched.

"...Don't look down at me."

C.Curo's smile deepened by the tiniest amount.

"I wasn't."

"You absolutely were."

"Hm?"

"You—!"

L.Night's face was already starting to turn red.

E.Red finally lost the battle and laughed.

"Ahahahaha—L.Night, she's taller than you!"

"E.Red!"

C.Curo calmly straightened up.

L.Night glared at her.

C.Curo looked back.

Still smiling.

This was their first day.

And somehow, L.Night had already found someone she desperately wanted to beat.
